title: Self-Inductance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the self-inductance L using the formula L = N^2 * mu_0 * S / l.

title: Mutual Inductance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the mutual inductance M using the formula M = N' * N * mu_0 * S / l.

title: Charge Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the charge q using the formula q = M * I / R.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the values for mu_0, S, and other constants in their calculations.

title: Integration Step
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Kirchhoff's law and integrate to find the relationship between induced emf and charge.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors when calculating induced emf and charge.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present final answers in a clear and correct format, including appropriate units.
